## Goal

Implement gh-174: person commands that need the tick lock wait up to 60s for a running tick instead of refusing `tick_locked` (B1–B16, Plan D1–D7).

## Progress

- Refine and plan done earlier (spec B1–B16, H1 amended; Plan S1/S2, D1–D7).
- implement#1: one helper `waitForTickLock` (`packages/cli/src/runtime/tick-lock.ts`): 250ms poll, 60s on the context clock, one stderr wait line via `ctx.log`, `tick_locked`/busy on timeout ("waited 60s") or abort ("interrupted while waiting…"), never takes the lock after an abort. New `CliDeps.sleep` + `Context.sleep` (D2). All person call sites routed through it: story edit --workflow/--at, story checkout, story reopen, tidy, `withStory` (close/reset/handoff), watch's exit release (signal null, D5). `tick`, `migrate`, `story edit --auto|--manual`, watch's per-tick lock unchanged. watch's private sleep replaced by the shared `abortableSleep`.
- Tests: `packages/cli/test/integration/tick-lock-wait.test.ts` (18 tests, red before, green now) covers B1–B12, B14, B15 plus one "waits, then runs" per command; B13 by the existing migrate test. Related integration files (machine-dir, story-reopen, story-reset, housekeeping, runtime, human, migrate) green; unit tier + typecheck green.
- Docs (B16): `docs/reference.md` "Output and exit codes" says which commands wait, 60s, Ctrl-C, and that tick/migrate refuse at once.
- Hand check with the dev build in a throwaway repo: Ctrl-C while `tidy` waits → wait line, then `tick_locked` exit 5 "interrupted…".
- implement#1 done: Person tick-lock commands now wait up to 60s via one helper (runtime/tick-lock.ts, injected sleep); 18 new integration tests cover B1–B15, docs/reference.md covers B16; unit tier, typecheck and related integration files green.
- implement#2 (rework, test.fail): the update from main brought `story wait` (#184), which added its own `CliDeps.sleep` with the same signature, so `context.ts` declared `sleep` twice (TS2300). Kept one field documented for both uses; `story wait` now calls `ctx.sleep` and its copy of the timer (`timerSleep`, identical to `abortableSleep`) is gone. Typecheck, unit tier, and story-wait + tick-lock-wait integration files green.
- implement#2 done: Fixed the test.fail typecheck error: merging main (story wait, #184) left two identical CliDeps.sleep fields. Now there is one, story wait uses ctx.sleep, and its duplicate timerSleep is removed. Typecheck, unit tier, and the story-wait and tick-lock-wait integration tests pass.

- review#1: approve, no blocking findings. Typecheck, unit tier (1113) and the tick-lock-wait, story-wait, machine-dir and migrate integration files green. Minor: B10's second command never actually waits; B8 uses a made-up pid rather than a reaped process; holder-time formatting duplicates watch's `clockTime`.
